notes.title: Social Distance Boxing - The New Normal!
notes.notes: A new game mode has been added to Olson's Boxing Challenge in light of recent events! The new challenge forces you to maintain your social distance from an infected opponent. Stay in doors and stay away from unnecessary places! We can get through all these times together.

notes.title: Footwork Update Version 1.2 - July 2019
notes.notes:
Olson's Boxing Challenge has received several quality of life fixes, game play adjustments, and refinement.
Change log:
- Stamina will now come back slowly while blocking
- Feet are now under the player when he is knocked out
- Animated Fireball, Stamina, Bear trap, and health icon now replace the old standard default powerup icon.
- Notifications removed
- UI clutter reduced. Still needs work
- Jabs slower at the end of punches at full extension of the arm.
- Player reaches forward more as he punches
- Animations slowed down and less Jittery
- Players will now not look at each other instantaneously
- While Blocking, opponent will not face player as fast when compared to having hands down
- Fade in animation added to start of Boxing ring scene
- Better Fireball impact added
- Scene Transition improvements
- Boxing Rings for each game mode now perfectly line up and will not shift around when game mode changes
- Bell Ring sound effect added

notes.title: Olson’s Boxing Challenge Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Jake Olson here again. 

I’m proud to announce that OBC is now for sale. It really excites me to know that the game is out in the wild for people to play. 

I look forward to discussing the game and adding content updates post release. The first content update will come out early December and I have Christmas updates planned as well after that! 

It’s going to be a fun few weeks after this so stay tuned!

I can’t wait to see you all in the ring!

-Jake Olson

If you need to reach me, the best place is twitter: @Jake__Olson

notes.title: Olson's Boxing Challenge Coming November 20th!!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

My name is Jake Olson, the guy that made this game. I'm super excited to share my project that I've been working on for the past couple of months. I'm confident that many of you will enjoy this title and have a lot of laughs while playing Olson's Boxing Challenge.

I'll be making more announcements and updates to the game post release. My goal is to have a close knit relationship with whatever community spawns from this game. Big or small, it doesn't really matter to me. Don't be afraid to ever email or message me with feedback, questions, or concerns with the game. 

If you need to get ahold of me quickly, twitter is the best option. Here is my username: @jake__Olson

Talk to you guys soon,
Jake Olson
